text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending extension of an existing signed parking prohibition on the south side of Strathcona Avenue. This is in response to concerns sent to Councillor Fletcher's office regarding vehicles parking close to the laneway east of Pape Avenue, south of Strathcona Avenue, and in obstructing sightlines of the contra-flow bike lane for laneway motorists. This proposal will result in the loss one on-street parking space.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Strathcona Avenue, between a point 84 metres west of Blake Street and a point 18 metres further west.
